parsed.explanation: The quoted text only labels Lemma D “proved” and gives a one-line reference to finite stabilization inside a fixed m. It does not prove, uniformly for all terms, that large primes can be erased or that S_infinity has finitely many minimal generators. Indeed, the write-up explicitly identifies finite generation/stabilization as the remaining crux. Numerical evidence and asserted supporting lemmas cannot establish L6.2.
